response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS a FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), o AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS m FROM compliancecase), q AS (SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.a, s.a - o.m AS diff FROM s CROSS JOIN o WHERE s.a > o.m) SELECT brokrepstat, a AS avg_modelconf, diff AS above_overall_avg, a / AVG(a) OVER () AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM q
